messages.content: Use web search to find relevant datasets. Only include landing pages or DOIs. Do not invent links. Do not call time, date, timestamp, or clock tools.

Query: Can you find datasets about International politics and organisations and Conflict, security and peace in France, Great Britain, Germany, and Italy during the 1960s, matching this research need: Public opinion survey data on Cold War security, the Cuban Missile Crisis, nuclear war and disarmament, attitudes toward NATO, the US, USSR and China, and support for European Common Market integration.
Respond ONLY as JSON in this exact shape: {"items":[{"title":"...","url_or_doi":"...","justification":"..."}]}. Put any DOI, URL, landing page, or link in url_or_doi.

queries: GESIS 1960s political attitudes four nations France Britain Germany Italy Cuban missile crisis NATO common market survey
ICPSR 1962 international public opinion Cuban crisis France Great Britain West Germany Italy survey
UK data service 1960s comparative survey nuclear disarmament NATO common market France Germany Italy
